note: Budgets for the venue portal — the Signal Studio Account surface at /hq/account-review (D-015 Q4: the Account is the Venue Portal, one surface, two names) — and for the venue-facing marketing and collateral pages in this repo. The couple workspace, public artifact and Timeline image budgets live in the app repo's copy of this contract. Every ceiling is a measured value from a real production build on the date stated, and may only be lowered. Raising one is a founder decision, not an edit.

shared_runtime.what: Client JS that every App Router route loads before any route-specific code: build-manifest rootMainFiles plus polyfillFiles.
shared_runtime.budgetBasis: contracts/launch-budgets.v1.json public.firstPartyJsGzipKb = 170, carried over unchanged rather than reinvented.
shared_runtime.ceilingBasis: Measured 168.4 KB gzip on the 2026-08-03 production build of branch claude/wp07-engineering-studio. The target is met with 1.6 KB of headroom, which is not headroom. The ceiling is set at 169 so any further growth fails immediately.

total_client_js.what: Every client chunk emitted under .next/static/chunks, gzipped.
total_client_js.budgetBasis: No prior target existed anywhere in either repository. Set equal to the measured baseline so the number can only ratchet down. Choosing a real target is a founder decision and is recorded as an open question on E08.10.
total_client_js.ceilingBasis: Measured 1360.0 KB gzip on the 2026-08-03 production build.

largest_chunk.what: The single heaviest emitted client chunk.
largest_chunk.budgetBasis: No prior target existed. Set equal to the measured baseline.
largest_chunk.ceilingBasis: Measured 132.5 KB gzip on the 2026-08-03 production build.

repo_images.what: The heaviest raster image checked into the public directory, uncompressed on disk.
repo_images.budgetBasis: 200 KB is the same no-regression rule used in the app repo. This repository does not meet it.
repo_images.ceilingBasis: Measured 656.2 KB on 2026-08-03: public/brand/collateral/venue/venue-deck-preview.png, across 378 repository images. THE TARGET IS BREACHED BY 456 KB, and the offending asset is venue-facing. Recorded, not hidden — see evidence/E08.10-performance-budgets.md.

unmeasured.reason: No RUM provider is wired. Verified 2026-08-03: neither repository has @vercel/speed-insights, @vercel/analytics, a web-vitals dependency or a useReportWebVitals call, and no CI workflow runs Lighthouse.
Same as lcp_p75_ms. INP additionally requires real user interaction and cannot be produced by a synthetic run at all.
Requires production traffic. There is none: no founding venue has been contacted.

Next 16 with Turbopack no longer prints the Size and First Load JS columns in the build route table, and emits no app-build-manifest.json. Per-route client weight cannot be derived from build output. shared_runtime is the measurable floor that every route pays.

contracts/launch-budgets.v1.json sets 8 queries per page. Nothing counts queries per page in either repository: there is no query-count instrument, no server timing header and no test that asserts a query budget.
